findings.headline: Migrate this createDynamic call to the dynamic(source) factory.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 removes createDynamic(component, props) in favor of the dynamic(source) factory, which returns a stable component driven by a reactive (optionally async) source; the <Dynamic component={...}> JSX wrapper still exists but is deprecated without a runtime warning.
findings.guidance: Read the complete component and props arguments. Compose the call as createComponent(dynamic(() => Component), props), or hoist const Active = dynamic(() => Component) to the component body (or the module, for a constant source) and render <Active {...props} />.
